title: Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval
title_zh: 来自邻近文本的低语：将标注共识重新视为视觉语言检索的推理时证据

paragraphs.en: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image’s own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate’s supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: https://github.com/nhatkhangcs/clip_consensus

paragraphs.en: Dual encoders such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) map images and text into a shared embedding space and retrieve by cosine similarity. This simple design supports zero-shot classification and image-text retrieval at scale, and later work has improved it through alternative losses, data curation, and scaling ( Cherti et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Gadre et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2023 ) . At retrieval time, however, each image is still represented by a single vector, and each image-caption pair is scored in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 CLIP（Radford et al., 2021）和 SigLIP（Zhai et al., 2023）这类双编码器将图像和文本映射到共享嵌入空间中，并通过余弦相似度进行检索。 这种简单的设计支持零样本分类和大规模的图文检索，后续工作通过替代性损失函数、数据筛选和规模扩展对其进行了改进（Cherti et al., 2023；Xu et al., 2024；Gadre et al., 2023；Fang et al., 2024；Sun et al., 2023）。 然而，在检索时，每张图像仍然由单个向量表示，且每个图像-标题对都是被独立评分的。

paragraphs.en: Many image collections offer more than the image itself. COCO and Flickr30K attach five human captions to every image ( Lin et al., 2014 ; Young et al., 2014 ) , and curated repositories often store alt text, descriptions, or other metadata alongside each picture. These captions describe overlapping but non-identical aspects of the scene: some content is mentioned by every annotator, while other details appear in only one caption ( Plummer et al., 2017 ) . Standard image-text benchmarks use them as queries or training targets, but not as evidence when a candidate image is scored.
paragraphs.zh: 许多图像集合提供的信息不止图像本身。 COCO 和 Flickr30K 为每张图像附有五条人工撰写的描述（Lin et al., 2014; Young et al., 2014），而经过整理的资料库通常还会在每张图片旁存储替代文本、描述或其他元数据。 这些描述刻画了场景中重叠但不完全相同的方面：某些内容被每位标注者都提及，而另一些细节则只出现在单条描述中（Plummer et al., 2017）。 标准的图文基准将它们用作查询或训练目标，但在对候选图像打分时却不将其用作证据。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 illustrates why these captions can help. For the query “A person in a grass field flying a kite,” image similarity alone prefers a photo of a person reaching for a Frisbee in tall grass, whereas the captions of the correct image, which describe people flying kites on a lawn, lie much closer to the query than its image embedding does. Using candidate-side text in this way is a form of database-side augmentation and late fusion, long used in instance retrieval ( Chum et al., 2007 ; Arandjelović and Zisserman, 2012 ) , document expansion ( Nogueira et al., 2019 ) , and retrieval over multimodal candidates ( Wei et al., 2024 ) . We do not propose it as a new method. Instead, we ask how much it actually helps frozen dual encoders, and how to evaluate it without leakage. We study a simple scorer: the support captions of each candidate image are averaged into a consensus direction, the image embedding is decomposed into a component along this direction and a residual, and the query is scored by a weighted sum of image, consensus, and residual similarity, with only two fusion weights tuned.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 说明了为什么这些描述文本能有所帮助。 对于查询「一个人在草地上放风筝」，仅凭图像相似度会倾向于一张一个人在深草中伸手够飞盘的照片，而正确图像的描述文本（描述人们在草坪上放风筝）与查询的距离远比其图像嵌入更近。 以这种方式使用候选侧文本是一种数据库侧增强与后期融合，早已在实例检索（Chum 等，2007；Arandjelović 和 Zisserman，2012）、文档扩展（Nogueira 等，2019）以及多模态候选检索（Wei 等，2024）中被使用。 我们并不将其作为一种新方法提出。 相反，我们探讨它对冻结双编码器究竟有多大帮助，以及如何在无泄漏的情况下对其进行评估。 我们研究一个简单的打分器：将每个候选图像的支持描述文本平均为一个共识方向，把图像嵌入分解为沿该方向的分量和一个残差，然后通过图像相似度、共识相似度与残差相似度的加权和为查询打分，其中仅调优两个融合权重。

sents.zh: 我们研究一个简单的打分器：将每个候选图像的支持描述文本平均为一个共识方向，把图像嵌入分解为沿该方向的分量和一个残差，然后通过图像相似度、共识相似度与残差相似度的加权和为查询打分，其中仅调优两个融合权重。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating such a scorer requires care. In multi-caption benchmarks, the query is usually one of the correct image’s own captions, so it must be excluded from that image’s supports. A natural remedy, leave-one-out (LOO), removes the query from the correct candidate only. Under LOO, the full scorer outperforms a tuned base-plus-consensus scorer by 5.3 to 8.1 points in image-to-text R@1 on COCO. Under a fixed support index, in which every candidate uses the same supports regardless of the query, this advantage falls to at most 0.7 points. A size-matched variant of LOO, in which every negative also drops one caption, recovers about half of the gap, so set size and query removal each account for roughly half of the inflation. The support captions themselves, however, help every encoder we evaluate.
paragraphs.zh: 评估这样的评分器需要谨慎。 在多描述基准中，查询通常是正确图像自身的一条描述，因此必须从该图像的支持集中排除。 一种自然的补救方法是留一法（LOO），即仅从正确的候选图像中移除查询。 在留一法下，完整评分器在 COCO 的图到文 R@1 上比调优后的基础加共识评分器高出 5.3 到 8.1 个百分点。 在固定支持索引下，即无论查询是什么，每个候选都使用相同的支持集，这一优势最多降至 0.7 个百分点。 一种与留一法规模匹配的变体，即每个负例也去掉一条描述，能挽回大约一半的差距，因此集合规模和查询移除各自约占了这种膨胀的一半。 然而，支持描述本身对我们评估的每个编码器都有帮助。

paragraphs.en: A leakage-free protocol. We evaluate candidate-side captions under a fixed support index, with every scorer tuned on the same objective and image-clustered bootstrap intervals, and release it as a standalone evaluation script.
paragraphs.zh: 一个无泄漏的协议。 我们在固定的支持索引下评估候选侧描述（captions），每个评分器都在相同目标上调优，并使用按图像聚类的自助法置信区间，同时将其作为一个独立评估脚本发布。

paragraphs.en: An account of the LOO pitfall. We show that LOO inflates the apparent benefit of a residual term derived from the same captions. A size-matched LOO, a random-support control, and an algebraic analysis show that the residual reduces to a candidate-dependent reweighting of image and consensus similarity, which yields at most a small text-to-image gain.
paragraphs.zh: 对 LOO 陷阱的阐述。 我们证明 LOO 会夸大源自相同字幕的残差项所带来的表面收益。 通过规模匹配的 LOO、随机支持集对照以及代数分析，我们表明该残差可化简为一种依赖于候选的对图像相似度与共识相似度的重新加权，其至多带来很小的文本到图像增益。

sents.zh: 通过规模匹配的 LOO、随机支持集对照以及代数分析，我们表明该残差可化简为一种依赖于候选的对图像相似度与共识相似度的重新加权，其至多带来很小的文本到图像增益。

paragraphs.en: Measurements of when candidate-side text helps. Text-to-image R@1 improves by 3.4 to 16.8 points with same-source human captions across nine frozen encoders, by 1.9 to 7.2 points with captions from an off-the-shelf captioner across six, and by at most one point with captions from a different annotation source across four. A paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side, the gains persist under corrected COCO positives, and on SugarCrepe and ARO they come from text-to-text matching against human descriptions of the image, not from better image-text grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 关于候选侧文本何时有帮助的测量。 在九个冻结编码器上，使用同源人工描述时，文生图 R@1 提升 3.4 到 16.8 个百分点；在六个编码器上，使用现成图像描述模型生成的描述时，提升 1.9 到 7.2 个百分点；而在四个编码器上，使用来自不同标注来源的描述时，提升最多只有 1 个百分点。 经过释义训练的文本编码器增强了文本侧，这些增益在修正后的 COCO 正样本下依然存在；而在 SugarCrepe 和 ARO 上，增益来自针对图像人工描述的文本-文本匹配，而非来自更好的图文对齐能力。

sents.zh: 关于候选侧文本何时有帮助的测量。

paragraphs.en: CLIP and ALIGN train dual encoders to align matched image-caption pairs in a shared embedding space, enabling zero-shot classification and image-text retrieval ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021 ) . Later work improves this recipe through scaling ( Cherti et al., 2023 ) , the pairwise sigmoid loss of SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , data curation in MetaCLIP, DataComp, and DFN ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Gadre et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) , and improved training as in EVA-CLIP ( Sun et al., 2023 ) . Retrieval has also been improved with hard negatives ( Faghri et al., 2018 ) , region-word or token-level interaction ( Lee et al., 2018 ; Yao et al., 2022 ) , and fusion or generative pre-training ( Li et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023a ; Yu et al., 2022 ) . A related line questions the one-to-one image-caption assumption during training, through multiple positives ( Bulat et al., 2024 ) , generated captions ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , richer image representations ( Lavoie et al., 2024 ) , or objectives that capture more than shared information ( Dufumier et al., 2025 ) . All of these change training; we keep the encoder frozen and change only how candidates are scored.

paragraphs.en: Augmenting each database item with related content is an established retrieval technique. In instance retrieval, average query expansion and database-side augmentation replace an item’s descriptor with the mean of its neighbors ( Chum et al., 2007 ; Arandjelović and Zisserman, 2012 ) ; in text retrieval, document expansion appends predicted queries to each document ( Nogueira et al., 2019 ) . Benchmarks with multimodal candidates, such as M-BEIR, score image-text pairs by fusing image and text similarities ( Wei et al., 2024 ) , and ECO re-ranks captions of a fixed image by their agreement with other captions ( Jeong et al., 2024 ) . The scorer we study applies the same idea to frozen vision-language retrieval, with each candidate’s own captions as the added text. Our focus is therefore not the fusion itself but how much it helps, which text encoder suits the text side, from sparse BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) to sentence encoders ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023b ) , and how to evaluate it without leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 用相关内容增强每个数据库条目是一种成熟的检索技术。 在实例检索中，平均查询扩展和数据库侧增强用条目邻居的均值替换其描述符（Chum et al., 2007；Arandjelović and Zisserman, 2012）；在文本检索中，文档扩展将预测的查询追加到每个文档（Nogueira et al., 2019）。 具有多模态候选的基准（如 M-BEIR）通过融合图像和文本相似度来为图文对打分（Wei et al., 2024），而 ECO 通过与其它描述的一致性对固定图像的描述进行重排（Jeong et al., 2024）。 我们研究的打分器将同一思想应用于冻结的视觉-语言检索，以每个候选自身的描述作为附加文本。 因此，我们的重点不是融合本身，而是它有多大帮助、什么文本编码器适合文本侧——从稀疏的 BM25（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009）到句子编码器（Reimers and Gurevych, 2019；Wang et al., 2022；Li et al., 2023b）——以及如何在无泄漏的情况下评估它。

paragraphs.en: Cross-modal retrieval can also be improved at inference time without any metadata, by normalizing scores against other queries. Inverted softmax ( Smith et al., 2017 ) and dual softmax ( Cheng et al., 2021 ) renormalize over the evaluated query set, and QB-Norm uses a separate query bank to reduce hubness ( Bogolin et al., 2022 ) . We compare against these methods to separate gains that require captions from gains that any normalization provides.
paragraphs.zh: 通过将得分与其他查询进行归一化，跨模态检索也可以在推理阶段无需任何元数据得到改进。 反向softmax（Smith et al., 2017）和双softmax（Cheng et al., 2021）在所评估的查询集上重新归一化，QB-Norm则使用单独的查询库来减少枢纽性（Bogolin et al., 2022）。 我们与这些方法进行比较，以区分需要字幕带来的提升与任何归一化方法都能带来的提升。

paragraphs.en: COCO and Flickr30K pair each image with five captions ( Lin et al., 2014 ; Young et al., 2014 ) , and Flickr30K Entities links entity mentions across them ( Plummer et al., 2017 ) ; Localized Narratives add a second, independent description of the same images ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2020 ) . Single-positive COCO evaluation misses many valid matches, which CxC and ECCV Caption correct with additional human and machine-verified positives ( Parekh et al., 2021 ; Chun et al., 2022 ) . Compositional benchmarks such as Winoground, ARO, CREPE, and SugarCrepe test whether models distinguish captions with the same words in different structures ( Thrush et al., 2022 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2023 ; Hsieh et al., 2023 ) ; Hsieh et al. (2023) show that blind text models solve many earlier benchmarks. We follow this concern and pair every compositional result with blind baselines that never see the image.

paragraphs.en: We compare Base , B+C , and Full (Section 3 ), each tuned by grid search on tune2500 with α = 1 \alpha=1 and the objective I2T@1 + T2I@1, separately for each encoder, scorer, and protocol; every baseline below is tuned the same way. Since the encoders stay frozen while two weights are fit on labeled data, we describe the scorer as encoder-frozen . Unless noted otherwise, results use the fixed support index of Section 3.5 , averaged over five folds. Under this index T2I@1 coincides with standard T2I@1, while I2T@1 has a single correct caption per query, so we report fixed-index I2T only as a diagnostic (Appendix B.1 ). paragraphs.en: Table 2 contrasts Full with a separately tuned B+C under the three constructions of Section 3.5 . Under standard LOO, Full leads B+C by 5.3 to 8.1 I2T@1 points on COCO and by 2.6 to 3.4 on Flickr30K, with every interval excluding zero. Under the fixed support index, the lead never exceeds 0.7 points. Size-matched LOO, in which every negative also drops one caption, lies in between, at 2.6 to 4.6 points on COCO and 0.4 to 1.4 on Flickr30K. Equalizing set size therefore removes roughly half of the inflation on COCO and half or more on Flickr30K. The remainder comes from the positive’s supports excluding the query specifically: the LOO residual of the positive keeps a small positive projection onto the query (0.009 to 0.034 on average), whereas residuals computed from other captions of the same image have none on average. A random-support control on SigLIP and CLIP ViT-L/14 confirms that the LOO gain requires supports that both exclude the query and describe the image (Appendix C.2 ).

paragraphs.en: B+C scores the supports with the encoder’s own text tower, which is not trained for paraphrase similarity. Replacing it with a sentence encoder changes the picture. GTE-large ( Li et al., 2023b ) over the four supports alone reaches 54.7 COCO T2I@1, comparable to the image-only Base of the strongest encoder, and fusing it with the image score beats B+C on every encoder and dataset, by 2.6 to 4.3 T2I@1 points and 3.1 to 7.6 I2T@1 points, with every interval excluding zero. BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) is a much weaker text side and falls below B+C in T2I on 11 of the 12 encoder–dataset pairs. The fusion also exceeds both of its parts, so combining modalities remains essential; what B+C leaves on the table is the quality of the text encoder. E5 and MPNet reach text-only accuracy close to GTE (Appendix D.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Multiple human captions per image are rare outside COCO and Flickr30K, so we replace them with four captions per image generated by Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . No query can then appear among the supports, and image-to-text R@1 is the standard 5-positive metric. Generated supports improve every encoder in both directions (Table 4 ), by 1.9 to 7.2 T2I@1 and 1.9 to 7.3 I2T@1 points, recovering 42 to 59% of the COCO T2I gain obtained with human supports. Generated captions alone retrieve worse than the image alone on every encoder, so the gain again comes from the combination. Because the captioner is itself a strong vision model, part of this gain may transfer its visual knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 在 COCO 和 Flickr30K 之外，每张图像对应多条人工描述的情况很少见，因此我们改用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B（Bai 等，2025）生成的每张图像四条描述来替代。 这样任何查询都不会出现在支持集中，且图像到文本的 R@1 即为标准的 5 正例指标。 生成的支持集在两个方向上都提升了所有编码器（表 4），提升幅度为 1.9 到 7.2 T2I@1 以及 1.9 到 7.3 I2T@1 个百分点，恢复使用人工支持集所获 COCO T2I 增益的 42% 到 59%。 在所有编码器上，仅使用生成的描述进行检索的效果都比仅使用图像更差，因此增益再次来自二者的结合。 由于描述生成器本身就是一个强大的视觉模型，这部分增益可能来自其视觉知识的迁移。

paragraphs.en: To remove same-source paraphrasing, we pair queries and supports from different annotation sources using Localized Narratives ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2020 ) , on SigLIP and the three encoders of Appendix H.1 . With human captions as queries and a single narrative as support, B+C gains at most 1.0 point, and tuning switches the support term off for both SigLIP2 encoders (Appendix E.2 ). Support captions are thus most valuable when they share the distribution of the queries.
paragraphs.zh: 为了消除同源改写带来的影响，我们使用 Localized Narratives（Pont-Tuset 等，2020），在 SigLIP 以及附录 H.1 的三个编码器上，将来自不同标注来源的查询和支持进行配对。 以人工描述作为查询、以单条叙述作为支持时，B+C 的提升最多为 1.0 分，并且调优会使两个 SigLIP2 编码器的支持项被关闭（附录 E.2）。 因此，支持描述只有在与查询共享相同分布时才最有价值。

paragraphs.en: The benefit of the captions grows with their number and falls with their quality (Figure 4 ). With a single support per image, B+C is at or below Base for the three SigLIP encoders, and the gain rises steadily up to four supports (Appendix B.4 ). We also replace a fraction of each image’s supports with captions of other images, never with query captions (Appendix E.3 ). With weights fixed at their clean values, the gain becomes negative at 60% mismatch ( − 1.6 -1.6 for SigLIP and − 4.2 -4.2 for OpenCLIP). Retuned weights stay at or above Base at every level, because tuning shifts weight back to the image; for SigLIP, it also switches the residual off at 60%. Fusion weights should therefore be calibrated to the expected support quality.
paragraphs.zh: 字幕的收益随其数量增长，随其质量下降（图 4）。 每张图像只有一个支持时，B+C 在三个 SigLIP 编码器上处于 Base 水平或更低，且增益随着支持数增加到四个而稳步上升（附录 B.4）。 我们还将每张图像的一部分支持替换为其他图像的字幕，但从不用查询字幕替换（附录 E.3）。 在权重固定为干净值的情况下，当不匹配率达到 60% 时增益变为负值（SigLIP 为 −1.6，OpenCLIP 为 −4.2）。 在每个不匹配水平上，重新调优的权重都保持在 Base 水平或以上，因为调优会把权重移回图像；对 SigLIP 而言，在 60% 时它还会关闭残差。 因此，融合权重应根据预期的支持质量进行校准。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SugarCrepe ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) , ARO-Order, and ARO VG-Relation/Attribution ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ) with supports that cannot leak the answer: every candidate of an item is scored against the image’s other human captions, which never include the positive. Table 5 adds three blind references that never see the image. A language model alone ( Radford et al., 2019 ) solves ARO-Order (97 to 98%) and outperforms every scorer on VG-Relation and VG-Attribution, so ARO cannot measure grounding for any scorer here. SugarCrepe is the exception: the blind language model scores 44.4%, below chance. There, scoring candidates against the captions of a random other item reaches only 61 to 67%, whereas the image’s own captions reach 84 to 86.5%, about as high as B+C. Support captions therefore help through text-to-text matching against human descriptions of the image, not through a preference for natural-sounding text, and not through better image-text grounding of the encoder. Full never improves on B+C by more than 0.6 points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SugarCrepe（Hsieh et al., 2023）、ARO-Order 以及 ARO VG-Relation/Attribution（Yuksekgonul et al., 2023）上进行了评估，所使用的支持不会泄露答案：每个条目的候选都与该图像的其他人类描述文本进行打分，而这些描述文本永远不包含正确项。 表 5 增加了三个从不看图像的盲测参照。 仅用语言模型（Radford et al., 2019）就能解决 ARO-Order（97 到 98%），并在 VG-Relation 和 VG-Attribution 上超越所有打分器，因此 ARO 无法衡量此处任何打分器的视觉接地能力。 SugarCrepe 是例外：盲测语言模型的得分为 44.4%，低于随机水平。 在那里，用随机其他条目的描述文本对候选打分只能达到 61 到 67%，而图像自身的描述文本可达 84 到 86.5%，与 B+C 大致相当。 因此，支持描述文本的作用是通过与图像的人类描述文本进行文本对文本匹配，而不是通过偏好听起来自然的文本，也不是通过打分器更强的图文接地能力。 Full 相比 B+C 的提升从未超过 0.6 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Over all 12,500 COCO eval2500 queries, Full with SigLIP ViT-B/16 moves 1,069 text-to-image queries from an incorrect to a correct top-1 relative to Base, and 392 the other way. Figure 5 shows randomly drawn examples of the first kind. The distractors that Base prefers share the broad content of the query but miss a specific detail: a sandwich with meat instead of a vegetable sandwich, or a desk with one monitor instead of two. The captions of the correct image tend to name exactly these details (“a vegetable sandwich sits on a paper plate”, “the computer desk has two monitors”), so the consensus term favors it even when its image embedding lies slightly farther from the query. The failures follow the opposite pattern (Appendix I ). Their queries are generic, several images fit them equally well, and a distractor’s captions agree with the query as closely as those of the correct image. Many of these errors are false negatives of single-positive evaluation, consistent with the gains under CxC and ECCV Caption (Section 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在全部 12,500 条 COCO eval2500 查询上，使用 SigLIP ViT-B/16 的 Full 版本相对于 Base 版本将 1,069 条文生图查询的 top-1 结果从错误变为正确，另有 392 条则相反。 图 5 展示了随机抽取的第一类示例。 Base 更倾向的干扰项与查询具有大致相同的内容，但缺少某个特定细节：比如带肉的三明治而不是蔬菜三明治，或者只有一台显示器的书桌而不是两台。 正确图像的描述往往会精确命名这些细节（“一份蔬菜三明治放在纸盘上”、“这台电脑桌有两台显示器”），因此即使正确图像的图像嵌入与查询距离稍远，共识项也会偏向它。 失败案例则遵循相反的模式（附录 I）。 这些查询是通用性的，多幅图像都能同样好地匹配它们，且干扰项的描述与查询的一致程度和正确图像的描述相当。 这些错误很多是单正例评估的假阴性，与 CxC 和 ECCV Caption 上的提升相一致（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest several practices for work that conditions retrieval on text attached to candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果为那些在候选内容附带文本上进行检索条件化的工作提出了几点实践建议。

paragraphs.en: Any construction that treats the positive candidate differently from the negatives can inflate a scorer’s apparent benefit. Leave-one-out differs in both set size and content, and the image-to-text gain of 5.3 to 8.1 points it produces shrinks to at most 0.7 points under a fixed support index. Where LOO cannot be avoided, a size-matched variant at least removes the set-size effect.
paragraphs.zh: 任何对正例候选与其他负例区别对待的构造方式都可能夸大评分器表面上的收益。 留一法在集合规模和内容上都存在差异，其产生的 5.3 到 8.1 分的图文增益在固定支持索引下最多缩小到 0.7 分。 在无法避免留一法的情况下，规模匹配的变体至少可以消除集合规模的影响。

paragraphs.en: The residual term looked essential until base-plus-consensus was tuned under the same protocol and objective. Its algebraic form then explained why: it only reweights similarities that the simpler scorer already uses. Each ablated variant should therefore be retuned, not evaluated with the weights of the full model.
paragraphs.zh: 在采用相同协议和目标对“基础加共识”进行调优之前，残差项看起来似乎是必不可少的。 它的代数形式随后解释了原因：它只是对更简单的评分器已经在使用的相似度进行重新加权。 因此，每个消融变体都应重新调优，而不是使用完整模型的权重进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We asked how much the captions attached to database images help frozen dual encoders at retrieval time, and how to measure it without leakage. Under a fixed support index, fusing image similarity with similarity to an image’s own captions improves text-to-image R@1 for every encoder we tested. The gain is largest when the captions share an annotation source with the queries, about half as large when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and close to zero when they come from a different source. The text encoder deserves as much care as the fusion: a paraphrase-trained sentence encoder over the same captions outperforms each dual encoder’s own text tower. The residual term that motivated our decomposition adds little. Its large image-to-text advantage under leave-one-out evaluation arises because the positive’s supports are built differently from those of the negatives, with set size and query removal each explaining part of the gap; under a fixed index, it reduces to a reweighting of image and consensus similarity. On compositional benchmarks, the gains come from matching candidates against human descriptions of the image, not from better grounding, and ARO can be solved without the image. We release the fixed-support-index protocol so that future work on candidate-side text can be compared on equal terms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨了附着在数据库图像上的描述文本在检索时对冻结双编码器有多大帮助，以及如何在不发生信息泄露的前提下度量这种帮助。 在固定支持索引下，将图像相似度与查询文本和该图像自身描述文本的相似度融合，能在我们测试的每个编码器上都提升文本到图像检索的 R@1。 当描述文本与查询共享同一标注来源时，增益最大；由现成的描述生成器生成时，增益约为一半；来自不同来源时，增益接近于零。 文本编码器值得像融合方式一样被认真对待：在同一批描述文本上，经释义训练的句子编码器的表现优于每个双编码器自带的文本塔。 促使我们提出该分解的残差项几乎没有贡献。 该项在留一法评估下表现出的巨大图像到文本优势，源于正样本的支持集与负样本的支持集构建方式不同，其中集合大小与移除查询各解释了部分差距；在固定索引下，它退化为对图像相似度与共识相似度的重新加权。 在组合性基准上，增益来自将候选与人工为图像撰写的描述进行匹配，而非来自更好的 grounding，而且 ARO 无需图像即可求解。 我们发布固定支持索引协议，以便未来关于候选侧文本的工作能在同等条件下进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The gains shrink as the base model becomes stronger, to about one point for BLIP-2 with ITM re-ranking, and they decrease with fewer supports per image (Appendix B.4 ). Several analyses (cross-source supports, fusion rules, residual variants, and the random-support control) were run on a subset of encoders. Each image is therefore indexed by one precomputed vector of the same size as its image embedding, and ranking with 𝐮 i \mathbf{u}_{i} reproduces Full’s top-1 on all 12,500 COCO eval2500 queries (score differences below 10 − 6 10^{-6} ). paragraphs.en: Fold standard deviations are much larger on Flickr30K than on COCO. The reason is that the Karpathy Flickr30K file orders each image’s captions by length: position 0 averages 18.1 words (68% have at least 15), and position 4 averages 7.9 words, whereas COCO positions are uniform (10.4 words). Base T2I@1 falls with position because short queries are harder (Table 9 ). The gain of B+C over Base is positive at every position for every encoder and is smallest at position 0, where the query is the most distinctive caption. Averaging over all five folds removes this positional bias.

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows the reverse case, in which Base ranks the correct image first and Full demotes it to second. Here the query is generic (“a double decker bus driving down a street”, “a skateboarder does a trick at an indoor skate park”), and the distractor that rises to the top is an equally valid match: another double-decker bus, another tennis player waiting for a serve, another skateboarder in a skate park. When several images fit the query equally well, the captions of a distractor can agree with the query as closely as those of the correct image, and the consensus term no longer separates them. Several of these errors therefore appear to be false negatives of the single-positive evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了相反的情况：Base 将正确图像排在第一位，而 Full 将其降至第二位。 这里的查询是泛化的（“一辆双层巴士行驶在街道上”、“一名滑板者在室内滑板公园做技巧动作”），而排名上升到最前面的干扰项同样是有效的匹配：另一辆双层巴士、另一名等待发球的网球运动员、另一名在滑板公园的滑板者。 当多张图像同样符合查询时，干扰项的标题可以与查询的吻合程度和正确图像的标题一样高，此时共识项就无法再将它们区分开。 因此，这些错误中有几个似乎是单正样本评估下的假阴性。
